summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. reporting the consolidated synthetic remote voting map for its Extraordinary General Meeting held on June 30, 2026. The meeting covers approval of an appraisal report and merger of Esfera Fidelidade S.A. into the company per Brazilian law, along with ratification of PricewaterhouseCoopers as the appraiser. However, as a routine EGM notice/meeting results with no special-situation catalyst itself, it does not represent a new special situation event. The merger was previously announced and is already proceeding. No deal terms are provided in this filing, and no board recommendation or advisor beyond the EGM agenda is detailed.
